items.summary: fix(onboard): report a failed Gateway restart truthfully in setup (#174767) The setup wizard's Gateway service restart printed a success message and then rejected when the restart failed, so operators saw 'restarted' for a Gateway that was not running. The shared onboarding owner now records restart failures as a failed state with the reason, keeps the progress line neutral, and the wizard shows the real error and recovery commands. Production net -1 LOC. Supersedes #173355, thanks @skyzhao1223. Fixes #173348 Co-authored-by: skyzhao1223
